messages:
Tammy: Hey team — GammaCorp POC tomorrow. Need a hosted API key we can hand them. Requirements: 1) rotate daily (24h TTL), 2) IP allowlist their office ranges, 3) read-only inference scope, 4) procurement asks how we revoke and audit. Can someone provision? @Ashley?

Ashley: Yep. Recommend ephemeral scoped keys (24h TTL). Quick Q: do they need embeddings too or just generation?

Tammy: Only generation for now (chat + completions). CIDR blocks: 203.0.113.0/24 and 198.51.100.64/26. Also want a single shared key for the POC.

Joel: Ok. I can create a short-lived hosted key pinned to those CIDRs. I'll give you the command to run if you want self-service, otherwise I can spin it up and post the token in 1-1. Note we avoid pasting tokens in public channels.

Joel: CLI example (do not paste token publicly):
```
redwood-cli keys create --ttl=24h --scopes=inference:generate --allowlist=203.0.113.0/24,198.51.100.64/26 --description='GammaCorp POC - sales' 
# returns: KEY_abc123... (store in vault)
```

Joel: API curl example for automation:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"ttl":"24h","scopes":["inference:generate"],"allowlist":["203.0.113.0/24","198.51.100.64/26"],"description":"GammaCorp POC"}'
```

Joel: For revocation you can either: 1) Console -> Security -> API keys -> Revoke or 2) curl POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys/<key_id>/revoke

Mina: Security notes: mark key as POC, log owner (Tammy). Require rotation every 24h (enforced by TTL). Add audit entry in ticketing system with key id. Do not ingest customer PII in prompts. If GammaCorp requests SSO-based access or Private deployment, escalate. :lock:

Ashley: Also FYI — If you want auto-rotation, wire a small lambda that calls the create API and updates the secret in your vault. We can share a template. For short-term POC, manual rotation is fine.

devops-bot: Request queued: KREQ-4521 created by Joel. Assigned to infra-ops for quota check. ETA 30m.

Joel: I've created the key as a scoped ephemeral key. Token posted to Tammy in DM. Key id: key_7f3b9 (do not share). Added notes: expires in 24h, allowlist applied.

Tammy: Got it — thanks. I'll DM the GammaCorp contact and set up a short demo. Procurement asked: how do we prove revocation? — reply: console screenshot + audit log export?

Mina: Yes. When you revoke, export the Audit > API Keys logs (CSV/JSON) and attach to procurement. That shows revoke event and timestamp.

Tammy: Perfect. I'll send CIDRs and open a procurement thread. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
